correctness.rationale: The source rational stability map has an analytic Jordan Taylor expansion R(hJ_n)=sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(h^k/k!)R^(k)(-h)N_n^k. The shift powers occupy disjoint subdiagonals, making each derivative sign necessary and sufficient. The explicit derivative bracket is 1+sqrt(2)-k+(3+2sqrt(2))h, strictly decreasing in k, so the last k=n-1 gives the iff including n<=3 and h=0 boundary. Independent symbolic coefficient/surd checks confirmed n=4 h=1/20 negative and h4=10-7sqrt(2), not merely a sampled experiment.
